meta.name: muapi-award-ceremony-video
meta.description: Generate a 15-second cinematic awards-ceremony video — a host announces a winner from the stage, a spotlight finds them in the crowd, they walk up to the podium, receive the award, and the LED display reveals their name and "THE BEST ACTOR".

copy.tagline: 生成15秒电影级颁奖典礼视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作专业颁奖仪式视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate a 15-second cinematic awards ceremony video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce a professional awards ceremony video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的获奖者和主持人照片，生成一段 15 秒的颁奖典礼视频，包含主持人宣布获奖者、聚光灯找到获奖者、上台领奖、LED 屏显示姓名和奖项等场景。
howto.when: 当你提到“颁奖典礼”、“奥斯卡”、“最佳演员”等关键词，或要求制作颁奖典礼视频时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一段颁奖典礼视频，获奖者是张三，主持人是李四。
say.note: Claude 会要求你上传两人的照片。

say.text: 制作一个奥斯卡风格的获奖视频，获奖者叫王五。
say.note: Claude 会询问主持人照片和获奖者照片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a 15-second awards-ceremony video based on your provided winner and host photos, including the host announcing the winner, a spotlight finding the winner, walking to the podium, receiving the award, and the LED display showing the name and award title.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "award ceremony", "Oscars", "best actor", or ask to create an awards ceremony video.

say_en.text: Generate an awards ceremony video with winner Zhang San and host Li Si.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for their photos.

say_en.text: Make an Oscar-style award video with winner Wang Wu.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for host and winner photos.
